gen-gf-bellota-gf-zcool-xiaowei: Distinctive from the first glance, Bellota hangs the ends of its s far from the spine and traces every stroke at one stylus width. ZCOOL XiaoWei is the gentler partner, a sans-serif whose strokes swell and thin ever so slightly.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-antiqu: Commanding and a little quirky, Bellota lets the ends of its s hang loose while Zen Kaku Gothic Antique stays smooth around every bend. One is built to be noticed; the sans is built to carry text.
gen-gf-bellota-gf-zen-kaku-gothic-new: Bellota's s throws its ends far away from the spine, and every stroke is traced with one stylus width, which gives it real character. Zen Kaku Gothic New holds back, its sans-serif curves clean and unadorned.
gen-gf-bellota-ibm-plex-sans: Every curve in Bellota is drawn without stress, and the s hangs its ends far from the spine, which gives the heading a stamped, singular look. And IBM Plex Sans keeps a wide channel into each bowl, so its plain sans text stays approachable.
gen-gf-bellota-zilla-slab: Chunky, uniform, unmistakable. Bellota's bold letters never thicken or thin, and Zilla Slab, a slab-serif with broad openings on its curves, would feel crowded if the heading shrank too small beside it.
gen-gf-bellota-text-clash-grotesk: Open shapes, no shading, plenty of presence. Bellota Text takes the heading with its confident c, e and s forms, and Clash Grotesk, a sans-serif with no thick-and-thin modulation, follows underneath in the same unfussy spirit.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-hind:
Bellota Text opens with commanding, unshaded curves.

Hind's sans-serif lowercase rises nearly to the capitals, so the text could look better a touch smaller than you'd expect, leaving the heading to dominate.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-nunito: Bold-looking and light-looking strokes never mix inside a word in Bellota Text, which gives the heading its distinctive hold. And Nunito's sans-serif bowls look cramped if the body is enlarged beyond the heading's reach.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-pilcrow-rounded: Bellota Text keeps its open, unshaded curves in the heading, and Pilcrow Rounded answers beneath with tall, generous sans-serif counters. Paragraphs would feel warm and easygoing.
gen-gf-bellota-text-fs-quicksand: Quicksand's tall bowls look like blown glass bulbs, with sans-serif bars of identical thickness running across each line. Bellota Text adds commanding, unshaded presence above it.
